location.landmark: Near Main Market commercial corridor, Onitsha

vision: To become a trusted technology training and ICT solutions provider that helps individuals and businesses develop practical skills and effectively use technology for growth and productivity.
mission: To provide accessible, practical and relevant technology education while delivering reliable ICT-related services that solve real-world problems.

coreValues.name: Practicality
coreValues.description: Hands-on learning with real projects that prepare students for immediate workplace and freelance success.

coreValues.name: Excellence
coreValues.description: Maintaining the highest standard in curriculum quality, student mentorship, and ICT service delivery.

coreValues.name: Continuous Learning
coreValues.description: Staying updated with rapidly advancing digital and AI technologies to keep learners ahead.

coreValues.name: Integrity
coreValues.description: Honest guidance, transparent operations, and authentic dedication to student empowerment.

coreValues.name: Innovation
coreValues.description: Embracing cutting-edge tools, artificial intelligence, and modern methodologies.

coreValues.name: Accessibility
coreValues.description: Making tech education beginner-friendly, flexible (physical & online), and welcoming to all backgrounds.

trainingApproach.summary: Our unique 6-stage practical learning methodology ensures every student transitions from beginner to job-ready builder.

stages.name: Learn
stages.desc: Understand core concepts and fundamentals without overwhelming jargon.

stages.name: Practice
stages.desc: Hands-on guided exercises under instructor supervision.

stages.name: Build
stages.desc: Develop real-world projects, apps, graphics, or systems.

stages.name: Test
stages.desc: Troubleshoot, debug, and review output for industry quality.

stages.name: Apply
stages.desc: Deploy to live production, build portfolios, or take on freelance/workplace roles.

deliveryModes.description: On-site intensive hands-on classes at our well-equipped ICT Center at 62 New Market Road, Onitsha North.
Interactive virtual sessions with live mentorship, recorded lessons, and project reviews for learners anywhere.

admission.details: No fixed session start dates. You can enroll and start your customized learning track anytime.

pricingPolicy.note: Pricing varies by programme, duration, and track depth. Specific prices are provided upon inquiry based on your learning goals.
pricingPolicy.pricingGuidance: Contact us on WhatsApp at 08165321429 for the latest schedule, track details, and installment options.

services.name: Software Installation & System Maintenance
services.shortDesc: Professional OS setup, essential business software, developer toolchains, antivirus protection, and system optimization.
services.details: We install and configure licensed Operating Systems (Windows/Linux/macOS), productivity suites (Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Creative Cloud, CorelDraw, AutoCAD), software activation, driver updates, virus & malware removal, and hard drive optimization.

services.name: CCTV & Surveillance System Installation
services.shortDesc: Reliable HD/IP security camera setup with remote mobile phone monitoring for homes, offices, shops, and warehouses.
services.details: End-to-end security surveillance solutions including HD coaxial and IP Network cameras, DVR/NVR configuration, night vision setup, motion detection alerts, mobile live viewing on your smartphone, and ongoing maintenance support in Onitsha and across Anambra State.

services.name: Solar & Inverter Power Installation
services.shortDesc: Clean, uninterrupted 24/7 solar and inverter energy systems for homes, businesses, and computer workstations.
services.details: Custom solar power sizing and installation, pure sine wave inverters, deep cycle/lithium battery banks, MPPT solar charge controllers, solar panel roof mounting, and emergency repair to ensure zero downtime for your appliances and tech equipment.

services.name: Corporate IT Support & Network Setup
services.shortDesc: Office LAN/Wi-Fi networking, printer sharing, data backup solutions, and routine IT consulting for businesses.
services.details: Structured cabling, business Wi-Fi access points, router configuration, network printer and file server sharing, data backup and disaster recovery planning, and retainer IT support for small and medium enterprises.
